phrases.text: Indeed, ˹it is˺ We ˹Who˺ sent this ˹Quran˺ down on the Night of Glory
phrases.head: The explanation of His statement, the Exalted: إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ (1) ("Verily, We sent it down on the Night of Decree").

phrases.text: And what will make you realize what the Night of Glory is
The Night of Glory is better than a thousand months
That night the angels and the ˹holy˺ spirit descend, by the permission of their Lord,
It is all peace until the break of dawn
